description: This file defines a Java interface, RequestBodyMapHandler, which provides a method to extract a Map from the body of a ServletRequest. It serves as a contract for classes that will implement the extraction logic from request bodies in web applications.

classes.name: RequestBodyMapHandler
classes.description: A Java interface for extracting a Map from the request body of a ServletRequest, typically used as a service input map.

methods.name: extractMapFromRequestBody
methods.description: Extracts a Map<String, Object> from the data in the body of a ServletRequest.
